problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet to transport nine distinct categories of cargo, each requiring passage through nine sequential distribution hubs. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is outlined below:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 8.553 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 13.209 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 14.905 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 17.906 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 13.846 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 14.562 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 12.218 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 12.565 per ton
* For Cargo Iota, revenue is 14.944 per ton

The handling duration, expressed in ton-hours, required at each hub for every cargo category is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, Hub 1 consumes 0.686 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 0.733 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 1.321 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 1.319 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 0.524 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 0.552 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.187 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 1.7 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 0.761 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Beta, Hub 1 consumes 0.513 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 0.287 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 1.154 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 1.151 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 1.303 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 1.184 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.386 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 1.766 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 0.771 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Gamma, Hub 1 consumes 1.633 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 0.608 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 0.796 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 1.09 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 1.135 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 1.528 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 0.247 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 1.529 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 1.651 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Delta, Hub 1 consumes 0.203 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 1.212 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 0.234 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 0.449 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 1.768 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 0.299 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.833 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 1.401 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 1.579 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Epsilon, Hub 1 consumes 1.415 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 1.565 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 1.518 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 1.811 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 0.848 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 0.889 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.369 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 1.154 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 1.421 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Zeta, Hub 1 consumes 0.863 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 0.954 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 0.906 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 0.271 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 1.526 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 1.224 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.795 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 1.528 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 0.947 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Eta, Hub 1 consumes 1.596 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 0.314 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 1.345 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 1.876 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 1.805 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 0.77 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 0.705 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 0.731 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 1.796 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Theta, Hub 1 consumes 0.816 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 0.944 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 0.793 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 0.679 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 1.766 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 0.999 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.162 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 0.922 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 0.804 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Iota, Hub 1 consumes 0.926 (ton-hours), Hub 2 consumes 1.811 (ton-hours), Hub 3 consumes 0.705 (ton-hours), Hub 4 consumes 1.454 (ton-hours), Hub 5 consumes 0.585 (ton-hours), Hub 6 consumes 1.837 (ton-hours), Hub 7 consumes 1.04 (ton-hours), Hub 8 consumes 0.738 (ton-hours), Hub 9 consumes 0.971 (ton-hours)

The cumulative handling duration allocated to each hub is strictly capped:
* Hub 1's total handling duration must not exceed 173.388
* Hub 2's total handling duration must not exceed 168.033
* Hub 3's total handling duration must not exceed 211.848
* Hub 4's total handling duration must not exceed 158.44
* Hub 5's total handling duration must not exceed 305.083
* Hub 6's total handling duration must not exceed 192.335
* Hub 7's total handling duration must not exceed 239.845
* Hub 8's total handling duration must not exceed 325.854
* Hub 9's total handling duration must not exceed 208.372

Under the imperative condition that for every hub—Hub 1 through Hub 9—the aggregate processing time remains within its prescribed limit, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize the firm's total revenue.
